name: rain_leaves

source.title: rain in the forest atmo field recording
source.author: Garuda1982
source.notes: 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo, 603 s of steady rain in a forest (Sony PCM-D100), drops pattering on leaves close by, mixed to mono. Chosen by the author over newlocknew's drops on ferns (865323), nyoz's tropical leaves (615747) and yaya-dc's night leaves (667775) (see SOUND_REWORK.md). Stretches picked for the most close drops (about 6 a second, drops 4 dB over their 1 s median, 0.8-6 kHz), none more than 8.5 dB over it (no spikes), level steady within 0.5 dB between halves (scratchpad pick_swells.py); 94.3 s was passed over for one sharper drop (true peak 4 dB over the others). Its 27 bigger drops (8-13 dB over the rain, sound-ambience.py) are left out.

shape: 2 s swells (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the calm and medium rain's, played with them where a rain sound lands on leaves (RainSurface.LEAVES), in place of most of it (the filtered rain keeps 0.3). Cut at the calm rain's average level (RMS about -46 dB); how loud it plays against the rain is set in code.
